title: Iván & Hadoum (SFF2026)
synopsis:
In a greenhouse in southern Spain, transgender man Iván falls in love with newly hired Moroccan colleague Hadoum. Amidst the harsh factory system, their secret romance soon becomes an obstacle to Iván's pursuit of a promotion. Escaping societal judgment, they seek refuge on an isolated beach. In this directorial debut, Ian de la Rosa explores boundaries of gender, class, and culture. Within an unequal world, only love can dissolve the invisible lines between people.

 

Teddy Award, Berlin International Film Festival
Seattle International Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
在西班牙南部的果園工廠裡，跨性別男子Iván愛上新入職的摩洛哥同事Hadoum。在冷酷的工廠體制下，愛情悄然在溫室醞釀，面對貨櫃搭成高牆的壓迫，兩人這場隱密的戀愛，終究還是成為Iván一直追求升職目標的窒礙。他們嘗試逃離世俗的眼光，走向與世隔絕的海灘，在海浪低沉的拍打聲中，重新尋回自己。導演Ian de la Rosa的首部長片，透過兩人的關係探討性別、地域、階級、文化與政治等的界限。在不平等的世界裡，唯有在愛的溫暖下，人與人之間的界線才會消失。

 

柏林影展泰迪熊獎
西雅圖國際電影節
